messages.text:
The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed both issues: only fewer moves replace a best score; equal or worse results preserve it. Sizes without a record now show `Best: none`.

All 140 unit tests and 77 browser tests pass, plus type checking and build. Changed files pass formatting; the full formatting check reports existing issues in 53 unchanged files.
